mechanism: Hydrocodone may increase risk of opioid-induced constipation and renal complications, while zoledronic acid requires adequate renal function and can cause nephrotoxicity; combined use requires careful monitoring of renal function and hydration status.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine clearance) at baseline and regularly during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; assess for constipation and consider prophylactic laxatives; evaluate renal clearance before zoledronic acid infusion.
